title: Black holes and causal nonlinear electrodynamics
summary: For generic theories of nonlinear electrodynamics (NLED) we investigate the implications of (a)causality on spherically-symmetric solutions of the Einstein-NLED equations that are asymptotic to a Reissner-Nordström (RN) spacetime. Equal-charge dyonic RN black holes are shown to be exact, but unstable, solutions of (acausal) ``Born-type'' theories. For {\it all causal theories} it is shown that the metric is singular at the centre of symmetry and that it has at most two Killing horizons, implying at most three ``phases": RN-like or S(chwarzschild)-like black holes, and naked timelike…
